title: Devlog Tráiler for My game Bounty Hunters
author: Ciso507
selftext: I got the spider mech animated on pixverse AND then i painted on top of it to refine the animation, also the glitch effect Is on me. Going to be releasing My 1st bullethell game  'Bounty Hunters' on steam on early release in about 1month. You can wishlist and support My game on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2507500/Bo…
